segments.text: All for One: an open-source support hub. AI drafts, humans approve.
segments.caption: WhatsApp → helpdesk, with AI that drafts and humans who approve

segments.text: A client sends a voice note.
segments.caption: Step 1 · A client sends a voice note

segments.text: The hub reads it: a bug, in Inventory.
segments.caption: Step 3 · Analysis: type, module, track

segments.text: A ticket is created. Mail suppressed, writes guarded.
segments.caption: Step 4 · Ticket #20001 created

segments.text: It's assigned to Maya, with the reason shown.
segments.caption: Step 5 · Assigned, with the reason

segments.text: One instant acknowledgement, the only automatic message the hub sends.
segments.caption: Step 6 · The only automatic message

segments.text: The AI drafts a confirmation. A judge scores it: point nine, against point seven.
segments.caption: Steps 7-8 · CONFIRM draft, judged 0.90 vs 0.70

segments.text: Nothing is sent until a human approves. Maya taps Approve.
segments.caption: Step 9 · A human approves in the chat app

segments.text: A proof run reproduces the bug on video.
segments.caption: Step 11 · Proof run: reproduced

segments.text: Maya approves the resolution, proof attached.
segments.caption: Step 12 · RESOLVE approved and sent

segments.text: Every step is measured, per person.
segments.caption: Step 13 · KPIs, per person

segments.text: مرحباً Jordan، سجّلنا طلبك، وMaya يتابعه الآن.
segments.caption: Replies in the client's language, right to left

segments.text: Coming next: a desktop console, and One, a voice teammate.
segments.caption: Coming next · All for One Desktop and Team Voice AI
One · AI teammate in All for One Desktop · powered by Claude · hands-free, interruptible, confirms before acting

clips.text: Morning, Maya — three approvals are waiting, one is urgent.
